long_biography.plain_text:
Steven T. Watson built his career in international investment management. After working as a buy-side analyst at Sanford C. Bernstein in New York, he joined Capital Group and covered Asian property and transportation, along with European transportation and utilities. He became an equity portfolio manager based in Hong Kong and now serves on the Global Solutions Committee.

Watson also chairs the Asian Corporate Governance Association, giving him a regional stewardship role alongside portfolio management. He studied French and finance at the University of Massachusetts and New York University, with additional Mandarin study in China. Capital Group is privately owned by senior employees, but Watson's individual stake, if any, is unspecified. His title does not make him the firm's founder or controlling owner, and client portfolios and group-wide assets under management are not his personal property.
